name: Archi: Koshtorys Ingest
description: Потік А: читає Кошторис (вкладка проекту + Графік_оплат), перевіряє K1–K11, preview або commit плану в project_metrics + payment_schedule. Викликається з DEMO Archi Agent.

parameters.query:
WITH pm AS (
  INSERT INTO public.project_metrics (company_id, project_id, contract_amount, profitability_plan_pct, profit_plan, cost_plan_team, cost_plan_subcontract, bac, planned_hours, planned_hours_by_stage, etc_plan_by_stage, real_rate_team_hour, koshtorys_spreadsheet_id, koshtorys_sheet, baseline_at, baseline_by, nearest_act_date, nearest_act_probability, nearest_doc_deadline, doc_issuance_probability, hours_remaining, percent_execution, updated_at)
  VALUES ($20::uuid, $1, $2::numeric, $3::numeric, $4::numeric, $5::numeric, $6::numeric, $7::numeric, $8::numeric, $9::jsonb, $10::jsonb, $11::numeric, $12, $13, now(), NULLIF($14,'')::bigint, NULLIF($15,'')::date, NULLIF($16,'')::numeric, NULLIF($17,'')::date, NULLIF($18,'')::numeric, $8::numeric, 0, now())
  ON CONFLICT (company_id, project_id) DO UPDATE SET
    contract_amount = EXCLUDED.contract_amount, profitability_plan_pct = EXCLUDED.profitability_plan_pct, profit_plan = EXCLUDED.profit_plan,
    cost_plan_team = EXCLUDED.cost_plan_team, cost_plan_subcontract = EXCLUDED.cost_plan_subcontract, bac = EXCLUDED.bac,
    planned_hours = EXCLUDED.planned_hours, planned_hours_by_stage = EXCLUDED.planned_hours_by_stage, etc_plan_by_stage = EXCLUDED.etc_plan_by_stage,
    real_rate_team_hour = EXCLUDED.real_rate_team_hour, koshtorys_spreadsheet_id = EXCLUDED.koshtorys_spreadsheet_id, koshtorys_sheet = EXCLUDED.koshtorys_sheet,
    baseline_at = now(), baseline_by = EXCLUDED.baseline_by,
    nearest_act_date = EXCLUDED.nearest_act_date, nearest_act_probability = EXCLUDED.nearest_act_probability,
    nearest_doc_deadline = EXCLUDED.nearest_doc_deadline, doc_issuance_probability = EXCLUDED.doc_issuance_probability,
    hours_remaining = EXCLUDED.planned_hours - COALESCE(project_metrics.actual_hours, 0),
    percent_execution = round(COALESCE(project_metrics.actual_hours, 0) / NULLIF(EXCLUDED.planned_hours, 0) * 100, 1),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING project_id, planned_hours, percent_execution),
del AS (DELETE FROM public.payment_schedule WHERE company_id = $20::uuid AND project_id = $1 RETURNING 1),
ins AS (INSERT INTO public.payment_schedule (company_id, project_id, "стадія", "подія", "дата_план", "сума_план", "ймовірність_план", "статус_план")
  SELECT $20::uuid, $1, x."стадія", x."подія", x."дата_план"::date, x."сума_план", x."ймовірність_план", x."статус_план"
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($19::jsonb) AS x("стадія" text, "подія" text, "дата_план" text, "сума_план" numeric, "ймовірність_план" int, "статус_план" text)
  RETURNING 1)
SELECT (SELECT project_id FROM pm) AS project_id, (SELECT planned_hours FROM pm) AS planned_hours, (SELECT percent_execution FROM pm) AS percent_execution,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM del) AS deleted, (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS inserted;
